newsitem.title: USA: Auto-By-Tel IPO postponed due to market conditions.
newsitem.headline: Auto-By-Tel IPO postponed due to market conditions.

text.p: The initial public offering of stock by Auto-By-Tel Corp has been called off, according to lead underwriter Montgomery Securities, due to poor conditions in the market for new stock.
The company had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer four million shares in a range of $9.50 to $11 each, which would have raised roughly $40 million for the company.

Auto-By-Tel is an Internet-based marketing service for new and used car buying. The company derives revenues from auto dealerships, which pay to subscribe to the service. Consumers can access information about cars and light trucks and make arrangements for purchases over the Internet.

The market for initial public offerings has been suffering from weak demand over the past few weeks, with many deals being priced at lower than expected levels and others being delayed until conditions improve.
